reason: Primary purpose is managing DSH web plugins from the web UI: marketplace browsing, install/uninstall/update flows, and post-install enable/disable control. Evidence in README and package metadata shows it ships a host-side API route set and a web client UI with global progress/overlay controls, confirming a plugin-management/administration tool.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DSH Web GUI 的插件市场插件，提供插件列表与安装管理，并显示持续可见的后台安装进度、可终止任务与重启提示。
summaries.en: A DSH web GUI plugin-market plugin that lets users browse and manage plugins, shows persistent background install progress, supports canceling install tasks, and indicates restart requirements.

capabilities: Provides plugin lifecycle operations (list/probe/installed/install/uninstall/update) through web-host routes
Runs install/update workflows with background progress tracking and supports canceling in-progress tasks
Enables enable/disable of installed plugins by writing profile bundle state
Adds web UI pages/overlays for plugin-market browsing and status visibility
